name: Deltarune: Here Come the Cats
summary: The Depths. A dark, grotesque abyss where dreams go to rot. Somewhere in the stretching expanse of rock and ash, two survivalists have taken hold: a moody deer monster, and an enigmatic scientist. Of course, the void is not empty. In the deep dark, a pack of hungry cats has been stalking the unlikely duo, waiting for the perfect time to strike... A Deltarune fan game built around a rhythm-based bullet hell boss battle.
